title: Phase-Textured Complex Viscosity in Linear Viscous Flows: Non-Normality Without Advection, Corner Defects, and 3D Mode Coupling
summary: We consider time-harmonic incompressible flow with a spatially resolved complex viscosity field $μ^*(\mathbf{x},ω)$ and, at fixed forcing frequency $ω>0$, its constitutive phase texture $\varphi(\mathbf{x})=\argμ^*(\mathbf{x},ω)$. In three-dimensional domains periodic in a spanwise direction $z$, $z$-dependence of $μ^*$ converts coefficient multiplication into convolution in spanwise Fourier index, yielding an operator-valued Toeplitz/Laurent coupling of modes.
